{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in research and development expenses, calculated from the current and previous year's 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly increasing R&D expenses may be investing in innovative projects that will drive future growth, but also face higher risks and uncertainties", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Plan Funding Status", "construction": "Ratio of pension plan assets to liabilities, calculated from the current year's 10-K filing", "rationale": "Firms with underfunded pension plans may face higher future liabilities and lower returns on equity", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in total employees, calculated from the current and previous year's 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing workforces may be expanding into new markets or increasing production, but also face higher labor costs and management challenges", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Average Age of PP&E", "construction": "Weighted average age of property, plant, and equipment, calculated from the current year's 10-K filing", "rationale": "Firms with older PP&E may be at a competitive disadvantage due to outdated technology and higher maintenance costs", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Foreign Sales Concentration", "construction": "Percentage of total sales derived from foreign markets, calculated from the current year's 10-K filing", "rationale": "Firms with high foreign sales concentration may be more exposed to exchange rate risks and international market fluctuations", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Executive Compensation Sensitivity", "construction": "Sensitivity of CEO compensation to stock price performance, calculated from the current and previous year's proxy statements", "rationale": "Firms with high executive compensation sensitivity may have stronger incentives for managers to maximize shareholder value", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Institutional Shareholder Concentration", "construction": "Percentage of shares held by institutional investors, calculated from the current quarter's 13F filings", "rationale": "Firms with high institutional shareholder concentration may be subject to greater monitoring and discipline, leading to better governance and higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Audit Firm Size", "construction": "Size of the audit firm, measured by total revenues or number of clients, calculated from the current year's audit report", "rationale": "Firms audited by larger audit firms may benefit from higher quality audits and greater credibility with investors", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director Board Interlocks", "construction": "Number of shared directors between the firm's board and other companies' boards, calculated from the current year's proxy statement", "rationale": "Firms with more director board interlocks may have greater access to information, resources, and networks, leading to better decision-making and higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Industry Diversification", "construction": "Herfindahl-Hirschman index of industry diversification, calculated from the current year's 10-K filing and Compustat industry classifications", "rationale": "Firms with more diversified industry portfolios may be less exposed to industry-specific risks and more able to capitalize on growth opportunities", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
